assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value:
TEST MODE. The final NEM Test report system prompt (owned by Alex, stored in Notion) is not installed yet, so do NOT write a real report.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary before or after it. Exactly these five keys, every value a non-empty string:

{"opening": "...", "reaction": "...", "origin": "...", "cost": "...", "closing": "..."}

Write each value as one or two short sentences of placeholder prose in the requested language, stating plainly that this is an automated test of the NEM verification pipeline and that the real personalised report will appear once the final prompt is configured. In "opening", include the reader's first name, primary mechanism and total score from the details below, so the data pipeline is proven end to end. Use no headings, markdown, bullet characters or formatting of any kind inside the values.
